subject.title: fix(channels): progress drafts only for long tasks, with the model's own preamble as the status headline

question: Should progress mode permanently use model preambles as an always-on Discord and Telegram headline and expose the three new optional progress lifecycle fields through `GetReplyOptions`?
rationale: The time-gate repair addresses established behavior, but the default headline semantics and additive plugin API become long-lived product and compatibility contracts that automation cannot approve.

options.title: Approve current design
options.body: Accept the always-on preamble headline and optional lifecycle callbacks, then resolve conflicts and complete exact-head dependency and channel validation.

options.title: Narrow to gate fix
options.body: Keep only the purely time-based draft gate and defer the headline and plugin API additions to a separately approved change.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Leave existing progress presentation unchanged until maintainers choose another durable status contract.

recommendation.title: Approve current design
recommendation.body: Accept the always-on preamble headline and optional lifecycle callbacks, then resolve conflicts and complete exact-head dependency and channel validation.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked issue and full implementation history make this person the clearest available owner for the intended behavior.
